editorial.name: Jellyfish Bloom
editorial.description: A clear umbrella blooms with sheer fabric tentacles above soft ivory layers. A floating jellyfish you can carry.
editorial.alt: Clear bubble umbrella with pale pink and pearl fabric tentacles over an ivory tunic and trousers
pieces: Sheer fabric cut into short tentacles
editorial.tip: Cut one yard into strips and tie them to the umbrella ribs. Keep strips above your knees. Bring your own scissors and thread.

editorial.name: Venus Flytrap
editorial.description: Green felt leaves and an orange mouth with soft white teeth turn a black base into a hungry houseplant. DIY assembly required.
editorial.alt: Green felt carnivorous plant collar with an orange mouth and white felt teeth over a black unitard
pieces: Green felt for a leafy collar and open jaw
Orange felt for the mouth lining
editorial.tip: Cut two broad leaves and stitch them into an open collar. Add orange lining and white teeth. Supply your own thread and fasteners.

editorial.name: Stained Glass Angel
editorial.description: A rainbow mosaic cape spreads like cathedral wings over ivory layers. Make the short cape from printed cotton.
editorial.alt: Wing-shaped rainbow stained-glass print cotton cape over an ivory tunic and loose trousers
pieces: Stained-glass print cotton for a short wing cape
editorial.tip: Round the corners of one yard into a short cape. Hem it and add your own wrist loops. The cotton is opaque; no frame is needed.

editorial.name: Lava Lamp
editorial.description: Orange felt lava blobs float on a black base between a silver cone cap and wide silver hip band. A playful DIY build.
editorial.alt: Black fitted outfit with orange felt lava blobs, a small silver cone cap, and a broad silver hip band
pieces: Silver fabric for a cone cap and hip band
editorial.tip: Stitch orange felt blobs onto black clothing. Wrap silver fabric over your own card cone and hip band. Supply card, thread, and fasteners.

editorial.name: Walking Thundercloud
editorial.description: A handheld cloud umbrella trails silver fabric rain above a black base, finished with a lightning pin. DIY assembly required.
editorial.alt: White cloud tufts on a clear handheld umbrella with silver rain strips over a black unitard and silver lightning pin
pieces: White polyester stuffing for cloud tufts
editorial.tip: Tie fiberfill tufts onto the umbrella ribs with your own thread. Add short silver strips. Twelve ounces makes scattered tufts; larger bags add fullness.
